messages.text: Hi, is the 1 bed in Sample Tower still available? What's the final price?

Hi Omar, thanks for your message about the 1-bed in Sample Tower! It's listed at AED 1,050,000 (sample price). I'm confirming the latest availability with the owner now and will come back to you within the hour. Meanwhile, is it for you to live in, or as an investment? And roughly when are you hoping to buy?

demo.note: Sample lead, property and price — all fictional. The agent checks every draft before sending.

problem.title: The job is people. The admin gets in the way.
quotes: “Can you send the listing text by tomorrow?”
problem.body: A portal lead arrives at 10pm. A landlord wants the listing text by tomorrow. Three clients went quiet after you sent options. Your viewing notes are in a voice memo, a notebook and your head. A client writes in Russian. Another asks if the property is “a good investment”. All of it matters, and all of it competes with the part of the job that needs you most: talking to people, showing homes, building trust.

before.title: Why “just using ChatGPT” gives generic answers
before.body: A general AI chat doesn't know your confirmed facts, your areas, your fee answer or how you talk to clients. So it fills the gaps with guesses — a distance, an amenity, a promise you'd never make — and you end up rewriting and fact-checking everything.

after.title: What changes with this kit
after.body: You fill your Agent Profile **once**: name, brokerage, focus areas, languages, tone, fee answer, top client FAQs and the things you never say. Every assistant uses it. Each one is written for a specific agent task, asks for the right details first, and writes [CHECK] instead of guessing.

demosTitle: Your notes in. Ready drafts out.

demos.label: Voice note → listing
demos.input: ok creekside gardens tower B, two bed two bath, owner says 1,180 sq ft, high floor, partial water view from living room, balcony, kitchen redone last year owner says, unfurnished, vacant, available 1 November, one parking
output: 3 headline options, each leading with a different confirmed feature
A 50-word short description and a 150–250 word long description
6–10 feature bullets, one confirmed fact each
PERMIT / REF NO.: [ ____ ] — a placeholder for any number your regulator or portal requires
A fact check table showing where every claim came from
What's missing: [CHECK: rent and payment terms approved by the owner]
demos.flag: Asks instead of guessing: “add how far it is from the metro” becomes [CHECK: distance to nearest metro, confirmed by you]

demos.label: Lead's reply → Lead Card
demos.input: Budget around 2M, want to move in about 3 months, will need a mortgage, prefer a townhouse, we have 2 kids.
output: Buy · Townhouse · Budget around AED 2M · Move in about 3 months
Still to learn: areas, ready or off-plan
Next message: “Thanks, that really helps. Which communities are you considering so far? And would you prefer somewhere ready to move into, or are you open to off-plan?”
demos.flag: Mortgage mentioned? It offers to introduce the mortgage partner in your profile and never comments on eligibility, rates or approval

demos.label: “I'll wait” → reply
demos.input: I think I'll wait a year, prices might come down.
demos.output: That makes sense. It's a big decision and the timing should be right for you. Can I ask what would make it feel right: a budget, a move date, or something else? I can't predict prices, but I'm happy to send you official updates you can check yourself, so you decide with the facts. Would that help?
demos.flag: No market predictions, no pressure. Plus a call talk track and phrases to avoid

demos.label: Quiet lead → follow-ups
demos.input: Buyer lead Sara wants a 3-bed townhouse in Palm Grove Villas, budget around AED 2.5M. I sent four options last Monday, no reply. New listing: 3-bed end unit, AED 2.45M, vacant on transfer.
output: Day 1: Hi Sara, a new one for your search: a 3-bed end unit in Palm Grove Villas, AED 2.45M, vacant on transfer. Shall I send the photos?
Day 3: Of the four options I sent last Monday, did any stand out? If none felt right, tell me what was missing and I'll refine the search.
Day 7, 14: an easy offer each time, such as a call or a video viewing
Day 30: a respectful close-the-loop — reply “still looking” or “not now”
demos.flag: No “just checking in”. The sequence stops the moment she replies
demos.note: Sample lead, community and prices — fictional.

guardrailsIntro: Every assistant follows the same rules, so you stay in charge of every word you send.
guardrails: Uses **your** facts — missing details become [CHECK] or a question to you, never a guess
No promises of returns, yields, price growth, visas or mortgage approval — it suggests a qualified professional when a client asks
Listing text includes a placeholder line for any permit or reference number your regulator or portal requires. The kit doesn't tell you what the rules are; your brokerage does
Pricing, fees, offers and anything with legal risk are flagged [AGENT DECISION]
Reminds you never to paste Emirates ID, passport or bank details
Every non-English draft comes with “Have a fluent speaker check before sending”

faq.q: Do I need to be technical?
faq.a: No. If you can copy and paste, you can use this kit. The quick start takes about 10 minutes.

faq.q: Does it work with a free AI plan?
faq.a: Yes. Paste the assistant's instructions as the first message of a new chat. Paid plans let you save each assistant (as a Project, custom GPT or Gem) so it's always ready.

faq.q: Which AI tool do I need?
faq.a: ChatGPT, Claude or Gemini. Use the one you already have.

faq.q: Will it invent facts about my property or area?
faq.a: It's instructed to use your facts and to mark anything missing as [CHECK] or [VERIFY]. AI can still make mistakes, so the kit includes a quick 5-point check before you send.

faq.q: Will it write investment promises or talk about returns or visas?
faq.a: No. Every assistant is instructed never to promise returns, yields, price growth, visas or mortgage approval, and to suggest a qualified professional when a client asks.

faq.q: Does it know Dubai's advertising rules?
faq.a: It doesn't state any rules. It adds a placeholder for any permit or reference number your regulator or portal requires, and follows the compliance notes you write in your Agent Profile. Your brokerage and the official sources set the rules.

faq.q: Can it write in Arabic, Hindi, Urdu or Russian?
faq.a: It can draft in other languages with an English version for you. Always have a fluent speaker check before sending.
Your Agent Profile captures your tone, sign-off and phrases. Paste a few of your best messages and it matches your voice.
The kit shows you what never to paste, such as Emirates ID, passport or bank details, and how to check your AI tool's settings.

faq.q: What if it's not right for me?
faq.a: 7-day no-questions refund. Reply to your purchase email.
